The *Vitakkattika* (Patthana 19.6) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In the overall structural organization of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the *vitakka-ttika* ("The Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'") stands as the sixth triad among the twenty-two primary matrix triads (*tika*) used to analyze conditional relations [Nyanatiloka 2007].

The secondary literature in the dossier does not discuss this specific sub-chapter in detail, citing it only as a structural heading within the division of the *Paṭṭhāna* [Nyanatiloka 2007]. SuttaCentral records no modern English translation and no direct parallels in other Buddhist canonical traditions [SuttaCentral].

Text-reuse data computed by DharmaNexus shows extensive Pali-internal overlap, recording 128 matching passages across 25 other Pali texts, entirely within the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its closest textual relationships occur with other *vitakka-ttika* treatments, most prominently the primary *Vitakkattika* (*Patthana* 1.7; 57 matches, sharing up to 15,176 characters), *Vitakkattika* at *Patthana* 13.6 (7 matches), and *Patthana* 7.6 (3 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares formulaic passages with paired dyad and triad chapters, such as *Tika Hetuduka* (*Patthana* 4.1), *Tika Saraṇaduka* (*Patthana* 4.8), and combinations in *Patthana* 23 [DharmaNexus].
